articles.description: Kupte Windows 11 Pro, Office 2019 nebo hry na sv. Valentýna od Goodoffer24.com! Jednoduše klikněte na odkaz nebo na domovskou stránku Goodoffer24.com.
articles.title: Skvělý dárek na sv. Valentýna od Goodoffer24.com!

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Fedora je od 10. února dostupná v Sýrii. Sýrie vypadla ze seznamu embargovaných zemí a Fedora Infrastructure Team mohl odblokovat syrské IP adresy.
articles.title: Fedora dostupná v Sýrii

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Ministerstvo zahraničí Spojených států amerických vyvíjí online portál Freedom.gov, který umožní nejenom uživatelům v Evropě přístup k obsahu blokovanému jejich vládami. Portál bude patrně obsahovat VPN funkci maskující uživatelský provoz tak, aby se jevil jako pocházející z USA. Projekt měl být původně představen již na letošní Mnichovské bezpečnostní konferenci, ale jeho spuštění bylo odloženo.
articles.title: Freedom.gov, portál pro obcházení cenzury

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána pro lidi zdarma ke stažení kniha The Book of Remind věnovaná sofistikovanému kalendáři a připomínači Remind.
articles.title: The Book of Remind

articles.author: |🇵🇸
articles.description: Grafický editor dokumentů LyX, založený na TeXu, byl vydán ve verzi 2.5.0. Oznámení připomíná 30. výročí vzniku projektu. Novinky zahrnují mj. vylepšení referencí nebo použití barev napříč aplikací, od rozhraní editoru po výstupní dokument.
articles.title: LyX 2.5.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: F-Droid bannerem na svých stránkách a také v aplikacích F-Droid a F-Droid Basic upozorňuje na iniciativu Keep Android Open. Od září 2026 bude Android vyžadovat, aby všechny aplikace byly registrovány ověřenými vývojáři, aby mohly být nainstalovány na certifikovaných zařízeních Android. To ohrožuje alternativní obchody s aplikacemi jako F-Droid a možnost instalace aplikací mimo oficiální obchod (sideloading).
articles.title: F-Droid upozorňuje na iniciativu Keep Android Open

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Svobodná historická realtimová strategie 0 A.D. (Wikipedie) byla vydána ve verzi 28 (0.28.0). Její kódový název je Boiorix. Představení novinek v poznámkách k vydání. Ke stažení také na Flathubu a Snapcraftu.
articles.title: 0 A.D. Release 28: Boiorix

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Multimediální server a user space API PipeWire (Wikipedie) poskytující PulseAudio, JACK, ALSA a GStreamer rozhraní byl vydán ve verzi 1.6.0 (Bluesky). Přehled novinek na GitLabu.
articles.title: PipeWire 1.6.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: UBports, nadace a komunita kolem Ubuntu pro telefony a tablety Ubuntu Touch, vydala Ubuntu Touch 24.04-1.2 a 20.04 OTA-12.
articles.title: Ubuntu Touch 24.04-1.2 a 20.04 OTA-12

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána (Mastodon, 𝕏) nová stabilní verze 2.0 otevřeného operačního systému pro chytré hodinky AsteroidOS (Wikipedie). Přehled novinek v oznámení o vydání a na YouTube.
articles.title: AsteroidOS 2.0

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: WoWee je open-source klient pro MMORPG hru World of Warcraft, kompatibilní se základní verzí a rozšířeními The Burning Crusade a Wrath of the Lich King. Klient je napsaný v C++ a využívá vlastní OpenGL renderer, pro provoz vyžaduje modely, grafiku, hudbu, zvuky a další assety z originální kopie hry od Blizzardu. Zdrojový kód je na GitHubu, dostupný pod licencí MIT.
articles.title: WoWee, klient pro hru World of Warcraft

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Last week was the main feature pull of Rust programming language updates for the Linux 7.0 kernel merge window. Most notable with that pull was Rust officially concluding its "experimental" in now treating Rust for Linux kernel/driver programming as stable and here to stay. Sent out today was a round of Rust fixes for Linux 7.0 that includes preparations for the upcoming Rust 1.95 release...

ARC Raiders, even though it's a PVP game at heart, can just as easily be described as PVP, on account of there being countless, mindless robots roaming the topside world and waiting for unassuming raiders to stumble into them. 


However, despite their fundamental role in the game, we haven't really seen expansions to the original ARC roster. That is, until now. 


Though previously teased in the 2026 roadmap for ARC Raiders, Embark has now given us the first actual trailer for this new murder machine. We don't actually see the thing, as the video only depicts several stormy scenes across the game's maps, but we do get to hear it. And the sounds that it produces are as ominous as they come, with this strange "Firefly" ARC likely being of the prowling kind, probably lying in wait among the foliage in which maps like Dam Battlegrounds and The Blue Gate are totally covered.




This is one of the first major ARC additions to the game. We've seen several others in the game that, unfortunately, do not appear as actual enemies, such as the Barons (only showing up as husks) or the theorized Kings or Emperors (that we see walking in the distance on The Blue Gate, towering over the horizon). It is only a matter of time before we get even more of these robots roaming the world, perhaps in special raid events where cooperation and teamwork will have to triumph over personal interest if victory is to be achieved.


As for the Firefly itself, some have already theorized that it could look like a snake, which would fall in line with my assumption that it's a predator or some other kind of silent killer meant to punish careless traversal through the moss-covered post-apocalypse. No exact release date for the Firefly has been given, but it's bound to come as part of the Shrouded Sky update on Feb. 26. Another ARC, or "ARC Threat," is to come in March, potentially expanding the roster even further.

The post Embark shares cryptic, terrifying tease of a new ARC—the ‘Firefly’ appeared first on Destructoid.

How to get Mega Energy in Pokémon Go


How to reach Super Max level in Pokémon Go


Once you Mega Evolve your Pokémon, you can start earning Mega Levels. To gain levels, you'll have to Mega Evolve that specific Pokémon. The more times you Mega Evolve, the more levels you get. All Mega Levels you gain are permanent, and they will remain there when the Mega Evolution ends.


However, reaching the Super Max Level isn't as easy as gaining Mega Levels. To reach the Super Max Level and unlock it, you'll have to use your Pokémon's Mega Energy. Up until the introduction of Super Mega Raids and Super Max level, all Mega-Evolved Pokémon could gain a maximum of three levels.




With the introduction of Kalos-World Tour, you'll be able to go past that threshold. Hence, you'll need to Mega Evolve to unlock Mega Levels, and then unlock your Mega Energy to reach the Super Max level. Super Max is the highest form of Mega Level (as of writing), and it's the strongest form of your Mega-Evolved Pokémon.


How to get Mega Energy in Pokémon Go


To get Mega Energy, you'll need to participate in plenty of Super Mega Raids. We already have a guide about how you can participate in Super Mega Raids. You'll also need to collect Link Charges, which are a new source of energy. Suffice to say, Super Mega Raids are extremely difficult challenges that you'll have to complete while coordinating with other trainers.

Super Battle Golf is a cute little title to try out with your buddies, and there can be some intense PvP action as all of you try to hole the same ball.


While you can't play alone, you can participate with your buddies or with other players. Let's look at how you can create a match with your buddies first.


Table of contents
How to invite your friends to Super Battle Golf
How to join lobbies in Super Battle Golf


How to invite your friends to Super Battle Golf


To invite your friends, you'll first need to add them on Steam. Once they're added to your Steam friend list, you can then add them to play with you in the same lobby. For that, press Start from the main menu. This puts you on the golf course, but doesn't start an actual match.


Press the ESC button, and you'll find the option to Invite. Select the friend(s) you want to invite. Once done, they will have to accept your request. Upon doing so, they will become part of the same lobby. Now, you can proceed to start a fresh round of Super Battle Golf together.


You can also create lobbies for strangers and join lobbies created by other players.


How to join lobbies in Super Battle Golf


Screenshot by Destructoid


From the main menu, choose Join. This will open the lobby window as shown in the image below. You can now pick a lobby created by another player to join. You can also spectate the fun if you want. Moreover, there are different filers you can use.


For starters, always join a lobby with less than 100 ping, as lag is an important factor to consider. Moreover, you can also join a lobby from this section that was exclusively created by your friends. There's also an option to hide lobbies that are already full. Overall, it's a neat way to matchmake and play with others if you don't have a friend to play Super Battle Golf with.

articles.description:
Resident Evil Requiem is just around the corner. The ninth mainline entry into the series, it is set to utterly revolutionize how the franchise approaches horror, taking us back to a devastated Raccoon City with nightmares more terrifying still skulking among the ruins. 


The game will unlock at different times for different people, so here is exactly when Resident Evil Requiem comes out worldwide. 


Resident Evil 9 release countdown 


Capcom itself is yet to confirm release times, but Sony did it for them, it seems, labeling exactly when the game will unlock in different regions on the PlayStation Store. Our countdown below will target Feb. 26 at 11pm CT, with additional release times to be listed below. 




Resident Evil Requiem's release time seems to be targeting Feb. 27 at midnight ET, with other regional timings revolving around that. Here are some converted times so you don't have to go out and do it manually:



10pm PST 


5am UTC


6am CET


10:30am IST


2pm JST



The ninth mainline entry in the long-standing Resident Evil series takes place in a post-nuclear Raccoon City. We take control of Grace Ashcroft, a protagonist far removed from others in the series. She is scared, terrified, and maybe even unqualified for the daunting task ahead of her, with her characteristics serving to elevate the scare factor to a whole new level. 




Of course, we'll also get to see Leon Kennedy come back to RPD for the first time in a long time, with RE9 set to be one of the most important story-wise in the entire series. 


Speaking of the story, there are countless leaks and spoilers dropping left and right, and you'd do well to avoid anything RE-related for a while, or at least until the game actually comes out.

articles.description:
Resident Evil Requiem is only a week away, but that hasn't stopped numerous leakers from sharing the game's content, including major story beats, with everyone. From streams to Reddit posts to clips on X, RE9 is being spread like wildfire, and it's not even out yet.


And Capcom has had enough of that. In a short statement on X, the company has kindly asked players to stop sharing the game around before it launches on Feb. 27, as it wishes for "everyone to enjoy the game's story and experience as much as possible." 


Before the leaks, significant plot points were spoken of in discussions and theories, with fans believing this could be one of the most consequential Resident Evil stories ever told.




I'm in that boat and would never want the surprise to be spoiled for me, because what would even be the point of playing the game? 


Those who do not comply and continue to release high-profile leaks will feel the wrath of Capcom's lawyers, who seem very trigger-happy now that the cat's really out of the bag. "Our legal department will continue to issue takedowns and deletion notices for leaks in order to preserve your day-one experience," the company stated. 


Resident Evil Requiem comes out on Feb. 27, i.e., next weekend, as of this article. People are so restless that they couldn't have borne to wait another seven days to see things for themselves, but just had to indulge in leaks and spoilers and, what's worse, in spoiling it for others.

The post Capcom kindly asks everyone to stop spoiling Resident Evil Requiem: ‘We really want everyone to enjoy the game’s story’ appeared first on Destructoid.

Despite fighting an existential war against Russia, Ukraine continues to make progress in the fight against online piracy. In a detailed submission to the U.S. government, Ukraine outlines various IP reforms, including proposed legislation that would pave the way for pirate site blocking. Ironically, the plans could put Ukraine ahead of the United States, which still lacks a 'no fault' site-blocking regime of its own.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Ukraine Paves the Way for Pirate Site Blocking, Despite Ongoing War

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Pay TV provider DISH Network has filed a complaint against 'DMTN IPTV' and its alleged operators, including one who posed as Breaking Bad's creator on Facebook. The lawsuit, filed in a New York federal court, is coordinated by the International Broadcaster Coalition Against Piracy. It accuses the Moroccan IPTV operators of widespread copyright infringement and seeks more than $21 million in potential damages.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Sues ‘DMTN IPTV’ in $21m Piracy Lawsuit; Operator Posed as Breaking Bad Creator

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a first-of-its-kind ruling, a Spanish court has labeled VPN services as "technological intermediaries," ordering them to actively block IP addresses that host illegal LaLiga matches. The "dynamic" injunction compels NordVPN and ProtonVPN to intervene, similar to local ISPs. But with both companies operating outside EU jurisdiction with privacy-centric business models, it remains unclear if and how the order will actually be enforced.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Spanish Court Orders ProtonVPN and NordVPN to Block Pirate Football Streams

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Through the Motion Picture Association, anti-piracy group ACE has requested two DMCA subpoenas at California federal courts, asking Cloudflare and Discord to identify the operators of pirate streaming sites. Spanish-language veteran HDFull is targeted in both, with ACE seeking to unmask several people connected to the site and its popular Discord server, which was abruptly shut down.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE Targets Pirate Streaming Site ‘HDFull’ Through Cloudflare and Discord Subpoenas

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

More than two years ago, Amazon sued a network of websites that sold pirated DVDs of Prime Video exclusives such as The Rings of Power and The Boys. The defendants, believed to be based in China, never showed up in court. This week, a California federal judge awarded Amazon $6 million in damages and granted a broad domain transfer request, targeting registrars and registries. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Amazon Wins $6 Million in Damages Against Pirated DVD Stores, Plus Domain Takeovers

South Korea's copyright agency is recruiting 25 people to monitor foreign-language piracy sites for illegal copies of Korean movies, dramas, webtoons, and music. The work-from-home positions pay minimum wage, are open to applicants of any nationality, and list the ability to handle malware risks as a job requirement.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: South Korea Seeks Multilingual Talent to Hunt Down K-Content Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

An Argentine court has expanded the crackdown on pirate IPTV services Magis TV and Xuper TV, blocking more than 70 domains, while ordering Google to disable sideloaded Android apps. As the pirate services suddenly went dark across the South American country over the past days, VPN usage in Argentina skyrocketed. Notably, the enforcement action follows shortly after a new US-Argentina trade deal was signed. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Argentina Blocks Pirate Streaming Services Magis TV and Xuper TV, VPN Usage Skyrockets

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Despite being sued by Spotify and several record labels, Anna's Archive has silently begun releasing the actual music files from its massive Spotify scrape. The shadow library's backend torrent index now lists dozens of new torrents containing approximately 2.8 million tracks totaling roughly 6 terabytes of audio data. This marks a significant escalation in the already historic standoff with the music industry.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Quietly ‘Releases’ Millions of Spotify Tracks, Despite Legal Pushback (Updated)

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Nintendo can welcome two new pirate site blocking orders in Europe at the start of the year. Last week, a Dutch court ruled in favor of local anti-piracy group BREIN, ordering NXBrew to be blocked. A few days earlier, a German court issued a blocking injunction against another Nintendo Switch piracy site, NSWPedia. Through voluntary cooperation deals, these orders are honored by the major ISPs in these countries.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Piracy: NXBrew and NSWPedia Targeted in European Blocking Efforts

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A California federal court has ruled that identity information obtained through DMCA subpoenas cannot be used for foreign copyright lawsuits, rejecting manga publisher Shueisha's attempt to use it outside the United States. The decision comes after the former operator of defunct piracy giant Mangajikan fiercely protested the request for a much broader order.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DMCA Subpoenas Can’t Be Used for Foreign Piracy Lawsuits, Court Rules

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Does shutting down major pirate sites simply drive people to other sites, or can it also increase legal consumption? According to a new study from researchers at Chapman University and Carnegie Mellon, the answer is both. Analyzing the 2015 takedown of Brazil’s iconic MegafilmesHD portal, researchers found that the choice to go pirate or go legal largely depends on their gender and financial means. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Research: Major Pirate Site Shutdown Boosted Visits to other Pirate Sites (and Netflix)

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The popular shadow library Anna's Archive has lost yet another domain name. The site's .pm domain was taken offline after international pressure on intermediaries continued to mount. That initially left the .li domain as the only option, but a Greenland-based backup was swiftly added.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Loses .PM Domain, Adds Greenland (.GL) Backup

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar

Huneault, U.S. Magistrate Judge DeMarchi concluded that allegations of bypassing YouTube’s "rolling cipher" protection are sufficient to state a claim for unlawful circumvention under the DMCA.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ‘Ripping’ Clips for YouTube Reaction Videos can Violate the DMCA, Court Rules

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
NVIDIA has asked a federal court to dismiss an expanded copyright lawsuit, arguing that authors failed to prove their books were actually used to train AI models. The chip giant says merely contacting Anna's Archive doesn't constitute infringement and challenges virtually every new claim in the amended complaint.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: NVIDIA: Contact With Anna’s Archive Doesn’t Prove Copyright Infringement

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After a decade of cat-and-mouse games, India’s site-blocking machine has evolved from basic ISP blocks into a global domain-deletion engine that also targets American domain registrars. This expansion is largely due to legal efforts by American companies, who applaud the "lock and suspend" orders while hoping to further increase their scope and effectiveness.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Rightsholders Applaud India’s “Lock and Suspend” Piracy Blockades

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After "awareness" campaigns that failed to move the needle for years, Denmark’s leading anti-piracy group is shifting to a more aggressive litigation strategy. The Rights Alliance confirmed it will begin filing civil lawsuits against individual students who are caught sharing even a single digital textbook. The anti-piracy group prefers not to mention the targeted platforms but says it uses undercover monitoring of private groups to gather evidence.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Danish Students Face Legal Action and Fines Over Textbook Piracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In a massive international operation a week before the opening ceremony of the 2026 Winter Olympics, Italian authorities have announced the dismantling of a global IPTV network. Dubbed "Operation Switch Off," the action targeted key infrastructure and a hierarchy of resellers that allegedly served millions of users worldwide.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Crackdown in Italy Shuts Down IPTV Services Ahead of Winter Olympics

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After more than two decades of surviving legal and political pressure, several titans of the Bulgarian file-sharing scene were dealt a major blow today. In what appears to be a coordinated international strike, law enforcement authorities from the U.S. and Bulgaria have seized the domain names of ArenaBG.com, Zamunda.net, and Zelka.org. While this is a serious crackdown, it doesn't come as a complete surprise. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Bulgarian Torrent Giants Zamunda, Zelka, and ArenaBG Seized in Joint U.S.-Bulgarian Operation

articles.description: Natočit "Kmen Andromeda" jako komedii je zajímavý nápad, ale jeho filmová realizace znatelně drhne a trvá téměř hodinu, než se film konečně trochu rozjede. Na vině je především režisér, pod jehož taktovkou značná část humoru nefunguje tak dobře, jak si scenárista představoval. Škoda, že nerežíroval třeba Sam Raimi, protože potenciál námětu byl značný. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Parazit z chlaďáku - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: První povídka bezva a dokonce měla něco jako pointu, což mě u Jarmusche příjemně překvapilo. Bohužel, druhá a třetí povídka mají jasnou sestupnou tendenci: Druhá nemá pointu a třetí ani děj. Pravděpodobně zůstanu u své zásady "Jeden Jarmusch za 10 let stačí". (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Otec Matka Sestra Bratr [Father Mother Sister Brother] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Varování: Dnešní podcast může být pro někohu psychicky nepříjemný a/nebo NSFW, pokud pracujete například na sekretariátu KDU-ČSL.
articles.title: Fukocast o zabíjení

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Solidní, kvalitně natočená kriminálka, ve které se trochu tluče její zasazení do současnosti se scénářem a postavami, které působí jako ze 70 let starého noir filmu. Nejpozději od poloviny stopáže je celkem jasné, jak která z mnoha postav dopadne, a pak se kolem toho hodinu kličkuje a klame tělem, což není tak sofistikované, jak se asi tvůrci domnívali. (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Cesta zločinu [Crime 101] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Jde o polobláznivou komedii, která nemá úplně špatný scénář a opakovaně jsem si při ní představoval, jak by které hlášky mohly dobře fungovat, kdyby je patřičným tónem pronášel Miloš Kopecký nebo John Cleese. Bohužel je ale celý film naprosto mimo co se týče hereckých výkonů a režie, což mě překvapilo, protože jsem si myslel, že Andy Fehu dobře zvládá filmové řemeslo. (Ilča 10 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Když se zhasne - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Oba tyhle filmy jsou ekvivalentem hororů, které v 80. letech vycházely na VHSkách (a nikdy se nedostaly do kin). Proč byste si měli kupovat vstupenku na tyhle, když na Netflixu máte sto podobných, polovinu z nich lepších? (Ilča 50 % / 30 %)
articles.title: Hororová dvojrecenze: Ozvěna [Whistle] - 40 % / Primát [Primate] - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Je radost sledovat, že Sam Raimi mohl zase jednou natočit přesně to, co chtěl. Scénář je překvapivě chytrý, postavy (obě dvě) se zajímavě vyvíjejí a dlouho jsem se v kině tolik nesmál (na místech, kde si to režisér přál). Jediný podstatnější problém pro mě představovalo posledních asi 10 minut, kdy se hrálo až příliš na jistotu, všechno bylo hodně předvídatelné a zdaleka ne tak chytré jako předchozích 100 minut. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: SOS [Send Help] - 70 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Opět standardní (tedy v měřítku světové kinematografie nadstandardní)  kvalita Paola Sorrentina. Audiovizuální perfekcionismus, dokonale vedení herci, nápaditý scénář. Dokonalosti "Mládí" tento film v mých očích nedosahuje především proto, že mnoho jeho scén je "jen" o dialozích a ne o audiovizuálních nápadech. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Milost [La Grazia] - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Distributor dělá velkou chybu, že tento film neprodává pod hlavičkou "Horor". Má totiž podobný námět jako spousta blbých hororů, ale na rozdíl od nich není blbý. Naprostá většina scén je nápaditá a atmosférická, herci jsou výborní (včetně Vrána) a pokud z filmu nejsem absolutně nadšen, je to především proto, že většina duševních rozpoložení hlavního hrdiny jde poněkud mimo mě. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Křídla smutku [The Thing with Feathers] - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Občas výtvarně zajímavé jako statické obrázky, ale animace není nic moc a místy až nepříjemná pro oči. Náznaky zajímavého worldbuildingu, ale celkově to působí jako hodně prokrácená adaptace nějakého extrémně obsáhlého zdrojového materiálu, ze kterého se cestou na plátno vytratila většina potenciálně zajímavých témat a zůstala jen další kopie E.T. - Mimozemšťana. (Ilča 30 %)
